description: Why a campaign's performance moved: compares the window against the one before it and attributes the change to cost-per-click vs conversion rate vs volume, with a confidence level. Use this instead of guessing when asked why something got better or worse.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer/account ID (required for Google)

days.description: Window length in days; the same length before it is the baseline

platform.description: Which platform the campaign is on

name: campaign_diagnosis
